violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED BEFORE INSPECTION ENDED. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION. CONSIDER HAVING ANOTHER EMPLOYEE OBTAIN CERTIFICATION TO ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK being used TO STORE GRINDER AND OTHER MATERIALS.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE ITEMS AND ENSURE HANDWASH SINK IS USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY. PLEAE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE. HANGRY JOE'S HOT CHICKEN (Inspection Date: 07/29/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: FRIED CHICKEN WINGS AT 73-75F ON RACK UNDER COUNTER NEAR FRYERS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PIC WILL COOL WINGS WITHIN THE PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS AND MAINTAIN AT 41F OR BELOW MOVING FORWARD.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: COLESLAW PREPARED ON 07/17 IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE PREPARED FOODS ARE STORED AND USED FOR NO MORE THAN 7 DAYS.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE TO EMPLOYEE IN PREPARING SANITIZER BUCKETS WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION DURING INSPECTION. PLEAE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: UTENSILS STORED IN WATER AT 73-77F IN KITCHEN AND FRONT SERVICE AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO REMOVE UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING AND REPLACE WITH CLEAN, DRY UTENSILS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions: CHLORINE
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH/CHLORINE test kit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED ONLINE ORDER DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE SERVING AREA TO HAVE A STAPLER, GLOVES, AND AN ENVELOPE INSIDE IT.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED IN WALK-IN COOLER: RAW CHICKEN STACKED ON TOP OF ONIONS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: PIC MOVED ONIONS TO A DIFFERENT SHELF AWAY FROM CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED ONE SPRAY BOTTLE OF CLEAR LIQUID UNLABELED AT SERVING STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: PIC LABELED SPRAY BOTTLE, INDICATING IT WAS TABLE SANITIZER.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the CEILING IN CORNER OF BACK HOT WATER HEATER ROOM is not maintained in good repair. OBSERVED A LARGE GAP IN THE CEILING TILES IN THE ABOVE AREA. LEAVES, INSULATION, AND DIRT APPEAR TO BE FALLING THROUGH THE GAP AND STICKING TO PIPING ON THE WALL.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. THE CEILING MUST BE SEALED IN THIS AREA SO NO CONTAMINATION CAN FALL THROUGH IT. IF IT IS DISCOVERED THAT PESTS ARE LIVING IN CEILING, PLEASE CALL PEST CONTROL AND GET FACILITY TREATED AS NECESSARY.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: flour at the breading station
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC ADDED LABEL.
